claude.performance_metric: no transaction; going concern closed and repurposed into foundation, still in existence ~12 years later (museum opened 15 June 2023)
claude.rationale: gap_45=0: no ownership boundary was crossed; per §2 the product (dining experience, T4) and its operating processes (T5) were deliberately discontinued together, not split across a transfer. gap_56=0: per §2/§4-P5 the operating/creative processes and the organization/people (Adrià, Soler, Albert Adrià) moved together into the foundation under the same leaders, no process-vs-organization mismatch. p4_pathway=0: §4-P4 documents no product-process disruption since there was no transfer, product and process ended in tandem. p5_pathway=0: §4-P5 states none — organization and creative process moved together into the foundation. t1_archetype=1 and t2_model=1 are the operative non-cascade channels documented in §4/§6 (founder-identity closure and structurally loss-making model).

gemini.performance_metric: organization is still in existence roughly 12 years after the restaurant closed
gemini.rationale: The dossier states that the restaurant was voluntarily closed rather than sold, meaning the product and its operating processes were deliberately discontinued together without crossing an ownership boundary (gap_45 = 0). Similarly, the organization and its underlying creative process moved together into the foundation under the same leaders, avoiding any process-organization mismatch (gap_56 = 0). Because there was no transfer, there were no post-transfer integration failures at either the product-process interface (p4_pathway = 0) or the process-organization interface (p5_pathway = 0).
